caption: The image shows two rectangular pieces of embroidered fabric mounted on a light background. The larger piece on the left is densely decorated with floral designs in colors including red, pink, yellow, green, and brown. The flowers vary in size and design, with some having layers of petals and different colored centers, and there are green and brown stems and leaves connecting the flowers. Among the flowers, there is a small embroidered bird with a red back, brown wings, and a white underside. The smaller piece on the right features a prominent large red flower with green leaves and a brown stem. Above this flower, a large butterfly is depicted with yellow, black, and white wings. Below the flower and butterfly, there is text that reads, "Ann Maria Kultz Wrought this sampler in the year 1833." At the bottom right of the fabric, the name "Chas Roadman" is written. The background fabric of both pieces is a light tan color, and the embroidery threads are rich in color and highly textured.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
